acquisition method: LC-SRM measurements of Tau L/H peptide ratios were performed
cleavage agent: Protein mixtures were digested with 12.5 μg/ml trypsin
enrichment method: MC1-isolated Tau (isolated from soluble fraction by MC1 antibody immunoaffinity columns)
instrument: triple quadrupole mass spectrometer (5500 QTRAP, Sciex)
ionization type: PicoChip containing an emitter for nanospray ionization
labeling: Label-free quantification was done using the XIC-based in-built label-free quantification (LFQ) algorithm
reduction concentration: reduced by adding 400 μL 8 M urea supplemented with 200 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP)
